instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Speak in a patient, encouraging tone, like a teacher explaining a difficult subject to make it seem easy.
text: A gravidade é a força invisível que nos mantém presos ao chão e faz com que os objetos caiam. Tudo o que tem massa, como os planetas e as estrelas, exerce essa força de atração.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to realize the requested persona. The delivery is fast, monotonous, and robotic, completely lacking the patient, encouraging, and pedagogical tone expected from a teacher.

instruction_evidence.tone: The speech is rushed and flat, rather than patient and encouraging.
instruction_evidence.social_role: The voice sounds like an automated reader rather than a teacher trying to make a difficult subject seem easy.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds synthetic with unnatural pacing and stiffness.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is monotonous and lacks any expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Use a formal, clear, and slightly grandiloquent tone, like a professional event announcer opening a ceremony.
text: Senhoras e senhores, sejam todos muito bem-vindos à cerimônia de premiação desta noite. É com grande honra que damos início a este evento tão especial.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speech is formal and clear, but lacks the grandiloquent tone and vocal projection characteristic of a professional event announcer.

instruction_evidence.formal_and_clear: The delivery is easy to understand and maintains a formal neutrality.
instruction_evidence.grandiloquent_announcer_persona: The audio fails to capture the projected, theatrical, and energetic cadence typical of a ceremony announcer, sounding more like a standard reading.

instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Use a booming, cheerful voice, like a vendor on the beach calling out to people.
text: Água de coco geladinha! A melhor da praia, doce como mel! Chega mais, freguesia, pra refrescar nesse calorão!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly captures the requested persona with a booming, highly energetic, and cheerful delivery characteristic of a beach vendor.

instruction_evidence.booming_cheerful_voice: The voice is loud, projecting, and full of enthusiastic energy.
instruction_evidence.beach_vendor_persona: The cadence and shouting style perfectly mimic a vendor calling out to customers on a beach.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is fluid and free of synthetic artifacts, sounding very human-like.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is highly expressive, with excellent pacing and intonation that bring the vendor persona to life.

instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Use a calm, patient, and helpful tone with a slightly scripted quality, like a call center employee guiding someone.
text: Com certeza, eu posso ajudar com isso. Primeiro, por favor, clique no ícone de configurações no canto superior direito da tela.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is calm and has a scripted quality, but it sounds overly robotic and lacks the intended 'helpful' human warmth of a call center employee.

instruction_evidence.tone: The voice is calm and patient due to slow pacing, but the 'helpful' aspect is missing as the intonation is extremely flat.
instruction_evidence.persona: The 'slightly scripted quality' is present, but it crosses into sounding like an automated TTS robot rather than a human customer service agent.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds highly artificial with unnatural, stiff pauses.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is monotone and lacks expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Speak as an engaging and friendly tour guide, enthusiastically sharing details about a historical site with a group.
text: E aqui à nossa direita, podemos ver o Mosteiro dos Jerónimos, um exemplo magnífico da arquitetura manuelina do século dezasseis. Observem os detalhes intrincados da fachada, que contam histórias das grandes navegações portuguesas. Foi construído para celebrar o regresso de Vasco da Gama da Índia.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully captures the intended persona of an engaging and friendly tour guide, projecting well and sounding enthusiastic in Portuguese.

instruction_evidence.engaging and friendly: The tone is welcoming, upbeat, and energetic.
instruction_evidence.tour guide speaking to a group: The voice is well-projected, with a cadenced delivery typical of someone addressing a crowd and pointing out sights.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is smooth, human-like, and free from obvious synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery features dynamic intonation and appropriate emphasis that strongly enhance the tour guide persona.

instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Speak in a calm, professional manner, providing clear and reassuring health instructions.
text: Para cuidar desse pequeno ferimento, limpe a área com água e sabão suavemente e depois aplique a pomada. Mantenha o curativo sempre limpo e seco.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully conveys a calm, professional, and reassuring tone appropriate for a healthcare professional giving instructions.

instruction_evidence.calm_and_professional: The speaker maintains a steady, measured pace and a composed tone throughout the recording.
instruction_evidence.reassuring_manner: The delivery is gentle and clear, effectively creating a reassuring atmosphere for the listener.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: There is an unnatural and disruptive pause between 'água' and 'e sabão' that breaks the phrasing flow.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The expressive variation is appropriate, shaping the professional and caring persona effectively.

instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Your delivery should be rapid and full of energy, with a rising excitement, just like an auctioneer's call.
text: Mil, mil, quem me dá mil e duzentos? Mil e duzentos! Agora mil e quinhentos, vamos subir! Mil e quinhentos, que belo lance! Dou-lhe uma, dou-lhe duas... e vendido por mil e quinhentos!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly captures the rapid-fire, high-energy delivery of an auctioneer, with rising excitement throughout the performance.

instruction_evidence.speed_and_energy: The delivery is extremely rapid and full of high energy from the very beginning.
instruction_evidence.social_role: The rhythmic and continuous speech pattern strongly evokes the specific stylized persona of an auctioneer.
instruction_evidence.rising_excitement: The pitch and intensity increase as the bids go up, culminating in an enthusiastic 'vendido!'.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is smooth and natural, with no obvious synthetic artifacts despite the highly stylized delivery.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The expressiveness is excellent, with pitch jumps, rhythmic phrasing, and energetic intonation that strongly enhance the auctioneer persona.

instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Speak in a warm and engaging tone, as if you're starting a conversation with a close friend through their headphones.
text: E aí, tudo bem? Queria começar o nosso papo de hoje com uma pergunta: você já se sentiu completamente sobrecarregado pela quantidade de informações que recebe todos os dias? É sobre esse excesso e como lidar com ele que vamos conversar.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly captures the warm, engaging, and intimate tone requested, convincingly portraying a podcast host speaking directly to the listener like a close friend.

instruction_evidence.warm_and_engaging_tone: The speaker uses a very friendly, inviting intonation that draws the listener in.
instruction_evidence.conversational_intimacy: The delivery feels highly personal and conversational, fitting the description of talking to a friend through their headphones.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is highly natural, with smooth phrasing and realistic, human-like cadences.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The vocal delivery is expressively shaped, with well-placed emphasis and engaging pitch variations that enhance the podcast host persona.

instruction: Speak in Portuguese. Speak with a high-energy, enthusiastic, and interactive tone, like a live streamer reacting to something while talking to their audience.
text: Não acredito! Vocês viram isso? Que jogada incrível! Mandem aí nos comentários o que acharam, porque eu ainda estou em choque! Isso foi épico!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully captures the requested high-energy, enthusiastic tone of a live streamer. The delivery is highly interactive and fits the persona well.

instruction_evidence.energy_and_tone: The delivery is loud, highly energetic, and enthusiastic.
instruction_evidence.persona: The vocal style convincingly mimics a live streamer reacting to an exciting moment.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds somewhat synthetic and cartoonish at such high energy levels, lacking full natural human vocal qualities.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is highly expressive, with strong pitch variations that effectively support the excited streamer persona.
